objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the elderly patient presenting with shortness of breath and a productive cough.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, for the past few months I’ve had shortness of breath when I exert myself moderately, and I’ve also had a slightly productive cough. I’ve smoked heavily for about 25 years, and I’m not having chest pain, fever, night sweats, or weight loss.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—such as twitching, jerking, shaking, or movements you can’t control? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any involuntary movements like twitching, jerking, or shaking.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves or shifts** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I don’t feel anything that moves or shifts when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, when I gently press or tap around my belly button area, it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a new lump or mass in your **right breast** (or a noticeable thickening that feels different from the rest)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any new lump or thickening in my right breast.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you notice that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a fogged-up window? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t noticed that my vision looks cloudy or hazy in either eye.”
